RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  July 29, 2010/Sravana 7, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Communications and Information
Technology; Culture; Earth Sciences; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science
 and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment; Space;
Tourism;  Urban Development; Water Resources;
Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Least developed naxal-affected
districts
*61. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
naxal-affected areas are the country’s least
developed districts;
(b) if so, the performance of the
implementation of various developmental
programmes of Government in these  areas;
(c) the reasons for the tardy
implementation of developmental
programmes in these areas; and
(d) the remedial steps that are being
taken to overcome the problems and
improve the implementation of centrally
sponsored developmental programmes in
the said least developed areas in the
country?
Scholarship for SCs/STs
*62. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has allocated,
released and spent large amount of funds
on scholarships, for the SCs/STs/OBCs and
the minorities for various welfare schemes;
(b) if so, the details along with
expenditure thereof during the last three
years, year-wise, scheme-wise and State-
wise; and
(c) the number of beneficiaries, State-
wise and gender-wise in each scheme?
Extradition of Anderson
*63. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken
any steps for the extradition of Anderson;
and
(b) if so, the steps that have been taken
in this regard?
19

20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
UN Convention against corruption
†*64. SHRI SHANTA KUMAR: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the date on which Government of
India signed the UN Convention against
corruption; and
(b) whether Government has ratified
this Convention?
Running of generator from
hydrogen gas
*65. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three students
of Delhi Technological University have
successfully run generator from hydrogen
gas;
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto; and
(c) the details of steps taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to encourage
such young scientists for further research
development in this regard so that
dependence on petroleum products can be
reduced in the country?
Centrally protected monuments in
Haryana
*66. DR. RAM PRAKASH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Centrally protected
monuments, archeological sites and remains
in Haryana; and
(b) the amount spent annually by
Government on their maintenance during
the last three years?
Mobile cloning
†*67. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DAVE:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether complaints regarding misuse
of mobile cloning are being received;
(b) whether Government has any action
plan to check such mobile cloning; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Telecommunication system in
Uttarakhand
†*68. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken by the
Ministry to strengthen the
telecommunication system in the districts
along the border in Uttarakhand;
(b) the details of status of
telecommunication in border districts at
present; and
(c) whether any special steps are being
taken by Government in this regard keeping
in view this border State?
Foreign tourists in Himachal Pradesh
*69. SHRIMA TI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of foreign tourists
visited the country during the last two years
and the current year;

21
(b) the details of the funds allocated to
Himachal Pradesh to attract foreign tourists
across the globe during the last two years
and the current year;
(c) the details of the foreign exchange
earned due to the inflow of foreign tourists
in Himachal Pradesh during the last two
years;
(d) whether any special scheme or
programme has been implemented during
the last two years to draw more foreign
tourists to the country; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Threat to people using RTI Act
*70. SHRI V . HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether despite an increase in
threats to people using Right to Information
Act for exposing corruption, CIC has
admitted that it neither has any mechanism
in place nor any guidelines to safeguard the
interests of such activists;
(b) if so, whether in the absence of
guidelines or a clear law it is left to the
Information Commissioner to take up the
matter with local police on condition of
anonymity;
(c) if so, whether in a number of cases
in various States, threat calls were used to
deter people to expose corruption in
various agencies; and
(d) if so, by what time a specific law
will be put in place to protect RTI activists?
Allocation of spectrum
*71. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of all spectrums allocated
since May, 2007 to Unified Access Service
Licence (UASL), Cellular Mobile Service
Provider (CMSP), Internet Service
Provider (ISP), National Long Distance
Service (NLD), Internatinal Long Distance
Service (ILD), or any other telecom license
holder, including company name, license
type, date of allocation, total payment made
as entry fee/one time charge and quantum
of spectrum allocated, date-wise; and
(b) the process of allocation of such
spectrums, whether on auction or on 'First
Come First Served' basis etc.?
Setting up of  new training camps by
Lashkar-e-Taiba
*72. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the Pakistan based militant group Laskhar-
e-Taiba that was responsible for 26/11
Mumbai carnage has expanded its
operations in Afghanistan and is now
setting up new training camps with the aim
of hitting more Indian targets;
(b) if so, whether Government has taken
up the matter with Government of
Afghanistan; and
(c) if so, other steps that have been taken
to apprise Afghanistan of the situation so
that effective preventive steps may be taken
in this regard?
Indo-Chinese cooperation on projects
in other countries
*73. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India and China have
decided to work together on projects in
other countries, in order to strengthen the

22
feel-good factor that would help them
tackle several irritants that lie in the way of
sound and stable relationship;
(b) if so, whether this has emerged out
of a long meeting between NSA and
Ambassador of China while reviewing the
entire gamut of bilateral relations;
(c) whether both sides have agreed on
the process of business connectivity and
joint working by the two countries; and
(d) if so, to what extent both countries
have agreed on joint cooperation in projects
in other countries?
Management of groundwater
resources
*74. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Bank report has
recently revealed that Government should
take urgent action through higher investment
in the management of groundwater
resources to reduce over exploitation;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard;
(c) whether the current trend of excess
groundwater use could run dry within the
next one decade; and
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Prosecution of retired IAS/IPS/IRS
officers
*75. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the number of senior retired officials
belonging to IAS/IPS/IRS cadres who have
been prosecuted during the last three years;
(b) whether pensionary benefits have
been permanently withheld in any case of
the prosecuted officers;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) under which provision of the rule
such benefits have been withheld?
Extension of JNNURM
*76. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of  URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
is planning to extend Jawaharlal Nehru
National Urban Renewal Mission
(JNNURM) to 28 more cities in the
country;
(b) if so, the details of the cities
identified, State-wise;
(c) to what extent the Public-Private-
Partnership (PPP) mode will help in
providing the required infrastructure in
about 28 identified cities in the country;
(d) whether any demands for adding
more cities from the States have come before
the Ministry; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and action
taken on those requests?
Haj Conference-2010
*77. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the Haj
Conference-2010 held on 8 July, 2010 in
New Delhi, it was emphasized that Haj
subsidy be abolished, global tenders be
allowed for Haj flights, quota for private
tour operators be abolished, malpractices
in accommodation in Saudi Arabia for
Indian Haj pilgrims be curbed, total Haj

23
quota for India be increased, passport to
Haj pilgrims be provided without further
delay, transparency be ensured in Haj
affairs, more powers be given to State Haj
Committees and Government Haj quota be
reduced, etc.;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) the other matters that were raised
therein; and
(d) the comprehensive action plan that
Government is preparing in all these
matters?
Expenditure on CWG-2010
*78. SHRI MANI SHANKAR AIYAR:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the total estimated expenditure on
the Commonwealth Games-2010;
(b) the expenditure to be incurred by
the Organising Committee;
(c) the expenditure to be incurred on
refurbishing existing stadia and other
Games-related sports facilities as well as
on constructing new stadia and other
Games-related sports facilities;
(d) the expenditure to be incurred by
the Government of NCT Delhi and other
authorities on Games-related infrastructure,
including city beautification, roads and
flyovers, airport up-gradation, new metro-
lines, etc.; and
(e) any other expenditure not covered
by above?
National Knowledge Network
*79.  SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
establish the National Knowledge Network
by connecting all knowledge institutions
through high speed data communication
network in the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether Government has allocated
funds for the said scheme;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) by when the said scheme will start
and be completed in the country; and
(f) the manner in which the scheme will
be beneficial to the country?
Voting rights to NRIs
*80. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of OVERSEAS
INDIAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
introduce a legislation to give voting rights
to the Non-Resident Indians;
(b) whether the legislation is proposed
to be introduced in the Winter Session of
Parliament;
(c) if so, essential features of the Bill;
and
(d) the details thereof?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 23rd July, 2010 Secretary-General.
Sravana 1, 1932 (Saka)
